_note: Weapon Research Explorer dataset (PoC). Values are from public / open sources and rounded; each critical spec carries a source_id + confidence. model_3d.fidelity = 'c' (visual approximation from public external characteristics) — recognition use only, not engineering-grade. Tags reference mil/data/tags.json by {type,value}.

weapons.name: Hsiung Feng III
manufacturer: NCSIST 國家中山科學研究院
weapons.summary_zh: 台灣自製超音速反艦飛彈，採整合式火箭衝壓引擎（ramjet）維持超音速巡航，具海面掠射與末端機動能力，部署於成功級/沱江級艦艇與岸置機動發射系統。
weapons.summary: Taiwan's indigenous supersonic anti-ship missile using an integral rocket-ramjet for sustained supersonic cruise; sea-skimming with terminal maneuver, fielded on surface combatants and coastal mobile launchers.

guidance.value: 慣性中途 + 主動雷達末端

changes.note: 延長彈體/燃料，射程大幅提升。

weapons.name: Tomahawk (BGM-109 / RGM/UGM-109)
weapons.summary_zh: 美國長程次音速對地巡弋飛彈，渦輪風扇動力、地形匹配與 GPS/INS 導引，可由艦艇（Mk 41 VLS）與潛艦發射；Block V 加入反艦與網路化打擊能力。
weapons.summary: US long-range subsonic land-attack cruise missile; turbofan powered with TERCOM/DSMAC + GPS/INS, launched from ships (Mk 41 VLS) and submarines. Block V adds maritime-strike and networked targeting.

propulsion.value: 渦輪風扇 + 固態助推

changes.note: 彈上重新瞄準、資料鏈與戰場評估相機。
Va 反艦（MST）、Vb 強化對陸彈頭 (JMEWS)。

sources.title: Tomahawk Cruise Missile — U.S. Navy Fact File

weapons.name: Harpoon (AGM/RGM/UGM-84)
weapons.summary_zh: 美國廣泛外銷的次音速反艦飛彈，渦輪噴射動力、主動雷達尋標與海面掠射；Block II 加入 GPS/INS 具備對岸與濱海打擊能力。
weapons.summary: Widely exported US subsonic anti-ship missile; turbojet, active-radar seeker, sea-skimming. Block II adds GPS/INS for littoral / coastal-target strike.

propulsion.value: 渦輪噴射 + 固態助推

guidance.value: 主動雷達 (+ GPS/INS Block II)

changes.note: 原型反艦構型，海面掠射攻擊。
多重掠海高度與再攻擊航路選項。
沿用 JDAM/SLAM-ER 的 GPS 導引套件。
彈道中途更新，抗干擾強化。

events.title_zh: 台灣岸置 HCDS 採購
events.title: Taiwan coastal HCDS buy

weapons.name: Standard Missile 2 (RIM-66/67)
weapons.summary_zh: 神盾艦區域防空主力，半主動雷達導引（末端），固態火箭與可拋式助推，經 Mk 41 VLS 發射。
weapons.summary: Primary Aegis area-air-defense missile; semi-active radar homing (terminal), solid-rocket with jettisonable booster, launched from Mk 41 VLS.

propulsion.value: 雙推力固態火箭 + Mk 72 助推

guidance.value: 慣性 + 指令中途 + 半主動雷達末端

sources.title: Standard Missile — U.S. Navy Fact File

weapons.name: Standard Missile 6 (RIM-174)
weapons.summary_zh: 多用途標準飛彈，結合 AMRAAM 主動雷達尋標器，具超地平線防空、末端彈道防禦與反艦打擊三重能力。
weapons.summary: Multi-mission Standard Missile using an AMRAAM-derived active seeker; over-the-horizon air defense, terminal BMD, and anti-ship strike.

propulsion.value: 雙推力固態火箭 + Mk 72 助推

guidance.value: 慣性/指令 + 主動/半主動雷達末端

changes.note: 21 吋大直徑火箭，射程/速度提升。

events.title_zh: 末端彈道防禦測試成功
events.title: Terminal BMD intercept

weapons.name: PAC-3 MSE
weapons.summary_zh: 陸基終端彈道飛彈防禦攔截彈，採直接撞擊（hit-to-kill）與主動雷達尋標，MSE 換裝雙脈衝發動機延長射程。
weapons.summary: Ground-based terminal ballistic-missile-defense interceptor; hit-to-kill with active radar seeker. MSE adds a dual-pulse motor for extended reach.

warhead.value: 動能撞擊 + 殺傷增強器

guidance.value: 慣性 + 主動 Ka 波段雷達尋標

weapons.name: AGM-158C LRASM
weapons.summary_zh: 以 JASSM-ER 為基礎的長程匿蹤反艦飛彈，具被動 RF 感測與自主目標識別，可在 GPS 受擾環境下作戰。
weapons.summary: JASSM-ER-derived long-range stealthy anti-ship missile with passive RF sensing and autonomous target discrimination; operates in GPS-degraded environments.

guidance.value: GPS/INS + 被動 RF + 成像紅外末端

weapons.name: Joint Direct Attack Munition (GBU-31/38)
weapons.name_zh: 聯合直接攻擊彈藥 JDAM
weapons.summary_zh: 將無導引炸彈加裝 GPS/INS 尾翼套件而成的精準導引炸彈，無動力滑翔投放；JDAM-ER 加裝彈翼延長滑翔距離。
weapons.summary: A guidance tail kit (GPS/INS) bolted onto unguided bombs to make precision-guided munitions; unpowered glide. JDAM-ER adds wings for extended standoff.

sources.title: JDAM — U.S. Air Force Fact Sheet

weapons.name: BrahMos
weapons.summary_zh: 印俄合作超音速巡弋飛彈，衝壓引擎維持超音速，具反艦與對地能力，可由艦、潛、陸、空多平台發射。
weapons.summary: Indo-Russian supersonic cruise missile; ramjet-sustained supersonic, anti-ship and land-attack, launchable from ship, submarine, ground and air.

propulsion.value: 固態助推 + 液燃衝壓

guidance.value: 慣性中途 + 主動雷達末端

changes.note: 縮小尺寸、更廣平台整合。

weapons.name: Naval Strike Missile
weapons.summary_zh: 挪威匿蹤次音速反艦飛彈，複合材料彈體、成像紅外尋標（無主動雷達放射），末端高機動航路規避防禦。
weapons.summary: Norwegian stealthy subsonic anti-ship missile; composite airframe, imaging-IR seeker (no active radar emission), highly maneuvering terminal routing.

propulsion.value: 渦輪噴射 + 固態助推

guidance.value: GPS/INS + 地形參考 + 成像紅外末端

changes.note: 可內置於 F-35 彈艙。

platforms.name: NMESIS (USMC)
platforms.name_zh: 陸戰隊 NMESIS 無人發射車

weapons.name: AIM-120 AMRAAM
weapons.name_zh: 先進中程空對空飛彈 AMRAAM
weapons.summary_zh: 美製主動雷達導引中程空對空飛彈，慣性/資料鏈中途、主動雷達末端，具射後不理能力；亦衍生為地基防空 (NASAMS)。
weapons.summary: US active-radar medium-range air-to-air missile; inertial/datalink midcourse, active-radar terminal, fire-and-forget; also basis for ground-based NASAMS.

guidance.value: 慣性 + 資料鏈 + 主動雷達末端

changes.note: 縮翼以內載於戰機彈艙。

weapons.name: MBDA Meteor
weapons.summary_zh: 歐洲主動雷達導引超視距空對空飛彈，採可調節流量固態衝壓引擎，末端具大「不可逃逸區」，透過雙向資料鏈更新。
weapons.summary: European active-radar beyond-visual-range air-to-air missile with a throttleable solid-fuel ramjet, giving a large terminal no-escape zone; two-way datalink.

guidance.value: 慣性 + 雙向資料鏈 + 主動雷達末端
